description: Figure 3 is a stacked vertical bar chart illustrating, by year, the number of datasets and how they are divided into “Untargeted” versus “Targeted” datasets. The horizontal axis is labeled “Year” and lists discrete years from 2012 through 2022 in increasing order. The vertical axis is labeled “Number of datasets” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 160, with regularly spaced tick marks at 20-unit intervals. Each year has one stacked bar with a legend titled “Targets” indicating blue for “Untargeted” and orange for “Targeted”; the blue segment forms the lower portion of each bar and the orange segment is stacked on top. From 2012 through 2015 there are no visible bars (approximately 0). In 2016 there is a small orange-only bar at about 10. In 2017 the bar totals about 30, with a small blue base (around 5) and an orange segment (around 25). In 2018 the total is about 50, with blue around 10 and orange around 40. In 2019 the total is about 70, with blue around 15 and orange around 55. In 2020 the total is about 130, with blue around 70 and orange around 60. In 2021 the tallest bar reaches about 160, with blue around 80 and orange around 80. In 2022 the bar totals about 60, with a small blue base (around 10) and an orange segment (around 50). The bars are ordered chronologically by year, and there are no additional visual emphases such as outlines or annotations beyond the legend and axis labels.
